intro.zh: 今天这批项目里，最明显的信号是「本地化」和「可控性」正在从边缘需求变成主流诉求：无论是跑在自己机器上的模型、本地模拟的云服务，还是给 AI 输出「去味」的工具，都在回应同一个焦虑——把关键环节握在自己手里。另一个变化是，围绕 agent 的周边工具开始细分化，从记忆、技能到工作流编排，不再只是又一个聊天框。
intro.en: Today's projects share a clear signal: local-first and controllability are moving from niche concerns to mainstream demands, whether it's models running on your own machine, cloud services emulated locally, or tools that strip the AI flavor from generated text.

zh.summary: 一个面向 AI 编程助手的规格驱动开发框架，让 AI 先写纯 Markdown 的需求和场景，人审完计划再写代码。它试图解决 AI 写代码时「跑偏」和难以审查的问题，已被不少团队用于真实项目。
zh.insight: 适合把 AI 引入研发流程但苦于质量不稳的团队，切入点是把「计划评审」变成强制步骤。和直接让 agent 写代码相比，它卖的是可审计性，可以往团队协作和合规方向做增值。

en.summary: A spec-driven development framework for AI coding assistants. The AI writes plain-Markdown requirements and scenarios first; humans review the plan before any code is written.
en.insight: For teams adopting AI in engineering but struggling with quality, the hook is making plan review a mandatory step.

items.description: Spec-driven development (SDD) for AI coding assistants.

zh.summary: 一个运行在 Android 手机上的端侧 AI agent，通过无障碍服务在后台隐藏屏幕操作 app 和网页，用户说一句话就能完成查聊天记录、比价加购物车等任务，同时不影响自己继续用手机。
zh.insight: 面向想做手机自动化但不愿依赖云端的用户，切入点是「后台执行不抢占屏幕」这个体验细节。和云端 agent 方案相比，本地运行在隐私和延迟上有优势，适合做垂直场景的自动化助手。

en.summary: An on-device AI agent for Android that uses accessibility services to operate apps and the web on a hidden background screen, so users can keep using their phone.
en.insight: Aimed at users who want phone automation without cloud dependency, the differentiator is background execution that doesn't hijack the screen.

items.description: An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.

zh.summary: Nous Research 推出的自我改进型 agent，内置学习循环，能从经验中创建技能、在使用中改进、主动搜索过往对话，并跨会话建立对用户的模型。可跑在廉价 VPS 或 serverless 上，支持多种模型切换。
zh.insight: 面向想要「越用越懂自己」的个人用户或小团队，切入点是长期记忆和技能沉淀，而不是单次任务执行。和一次性对话 agent 相比，它的价值随时间累积，适合做个人助理或垂直领域长期陪伴型产品。

en.summary: A self-improving agent from Nous Research with a built-in learning loop: it creates skills from experience, refines them in use, searches past conversations,
en.insight: For individuals or small teams wanting an assistant that knows them better over time, the hook is long-term memory and skill accumulation rather than one-off…

items.description: The agent that grows with you

zh.summary: 一个用一份 YAML 配置微调 LLM 的工具，通过层流式加载把冻结的基座模型逐层送进 GPU，从而在 4GB 显存的笔记本 GPU 上微调 8B 模型，结果与常驻显存运行逐位一致。
zh.insight: 面向只有消费级显卡、又想自己微调模型的个人开发者和小团队，切入点是「把微调门槛降到笔记本级别」。和租云 GPU 相比，它在成本和数据隐私上有优势，适合做垂直领域的小模型定制。

en.summary: A tool that fine-tunes LLMs from a single YAML config. Layer streaming feeds the frozen base model to the GPU one decoder layer at a time,
en.insight: For individual developers and small teams with only consumer GPUs who want to fine-tune, the hook is lowering the barrier to laptop level.

items.description: Fine-tune LLMs from one YAML. Layer streaming trains an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 一个用 Rust 写的 git worktree 管理 CLI，专为并行运行多个 AI agent 设计，把 worktree 操作简化到和分支一样简单，并提供 hooks 和写时复制构建缓存来管理多个并行改动。
zh.insight: 面向同时跑多个 coding agent 的重度用户或小团队，切入点是「多 agent 并行时的目录和构建隔离」这个具体痛点。它更像基础设施型工具，适合作为 agent 工作流里的底层组件，而不是独立产品。

en.summary: A Rust CLI for managing git worktrees, built for running multiple AI agents in parallel. It makes worktrees as easy as branches,
en.insight: Targets heavy users or small teams running several coding agents at once, solving the concrete pain of directory and build isolation during parallel runs.

items.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows

zh.summary: 一个纯 Rust 的净室引擎，指向任意网站、应用或游戏，用检查工具研究其运作方式，再让 coding agent 构建一个新版本，并对照原版反复检查修正。它把「看懂并复刻」变成了一条可执行的流水线。
zh.insight: 适合做竞品分析、教学演示或遗留系统重建的团队，切入点是「先理解再动手」的自动化。和直接让 AI 写代码相比，它多了对照原版的验证环节，可以往代码迁移和现代化改造场景靠。

en.summary: A clean-room engine in pure Rust that points at any website, app, or game, studies how it works with inspection tools,
en.insight: For teams doing competitive analysis, teaching demos, or legacy rebuilds, the angle is automating understand-then-build.

items.description: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.

zh.summary: 一个免费开源的本地 AWS 模拟器，无需云账号、token 或付费功能门槛，用 docker compose 就能在本地跑起 S3、SQS、EC2 等服务，兼容现有 SDK 和 Terraform 工作流，并声称可直接替换 LocalStack。
zh.insight: 适合做 CI 成本敏感或对数据出境有顾虑的团队，把集成测试从云端搬到本地。和 LocalStack 的差别在于没有功能门禁，可以切入「LocalStack 免费版不够用」的中小团队迁移场景。

en.summary: A free, open-source local AWS emulator that runs S3, SQS, EC2 and more via docker compose, with no account, token, or paid feature gates.
en.insight: A good fit for teams with CI cost pressure or data-residency concerns who want integration tests off the cloud.

items.description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative

zh.summary: 一个高性能的自托管照片和视频管理方案，常被视为 Google Photos 的开源替代，支持移动端备份、人脸识别和相册管理，社区活跃、多语言完善，适合在意照片隐私和长期存储成本的用户。
zh.insight: 对家庭用户和小型工作室来说，切入点是「把照片从订阅制云服务里拿回来」。它本身已是成熟基础设施，创业机会更多在托管部署、迁移服务和家庭 NAS 配套上，而不是重做一个相册。

en.summary: A high-performance self-hosted photo and video manager, widely seen as the open-source Google Photos alternative.
en.insight: For families and small studios, the pitch is taking photos back from subscription clouds. The project itself is mature infrastructure,

items.description: High performance self-hosted photo and video management solution.

zh.summary: 一个 agent skill，基于维基百科编辑识别 AI 写作的指南，把 AI 生成的文本改写成更像人写的，同时不改变原意。支持 Claude Code、Codex 等主流 agent。它解决的是内容创作者和团队对「一眼假」文案的尴尬。
zh.insight: 面向做内容营销、公关稿或教育批改的团队，可以把它做成写作流程里的「发布前检查」环节，而不是事后返工。和通用改写工具不同，它的规则来自人类审稿经验，更贴近真实读者的判断。

en.summary: An agent skill that rewrites AI-generated text to sound human, built on Wikipedia's guide for spotting machine writing, without changing meaning.
en.insight: For content, PR, or education teams, this fits as a pre-publish check inside the writing workflow rather than a post-hoc fix.

items.description: Agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text

zh.summary: 一个 agent skill，能把技术概念画成可交互的等距插画：它会让 AI 发明一个物理对象，让这个对象的运作方式正好解释该概念，输出精细的 SVG，可选 WebGL 着色器和 3D 效果。
zh.insight: 适合做技术教育、文档或科普内容的团队，切入点是「用可交互图解替代大段文字解释」。和普通文生图不同，它输出的是结构化的 SVG，可以嵌入网页并交互，适合做知识付费或教材配套。

en.summary: An agent skill that turns technical ideas into interactive isometric illustrations. The AI invents a physical object whose workings explain the concept,
en.insight: For technical education, docs, or science content teams, the angle is replacing walls of text with interactive diagrams.

items.description: An agent skill for creating detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of real-world machines and complex systems. Generates polished SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects.
